cheapo_ads.title: Cheap-O-Rama
cheapo_ads.//: Story Phase 16 (chapter 187): CHEAP-O-RAMA's advert for THE GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND LIGHTER OF GRAND SMOKES, with Cheapy the Cheapskate Clown (original: a lanky fellow in a checked suit, a bowler with the price tag still on, a coupon for a bow tie). It came on the Mark II by itself.

beats.line: cheapy: HI-DEE-HO, FOLKS! It's CHEAPY, from CHEAP-O-RAMA!
cheapy: Is YOUR Grand Stenchmaster lacking GRANDNESS? Is your cigar unlit? Is your ceremony un-ceremonied?
cheapy: Introducing THE GRAND STENCHMASTER'S GRAND LIGHTER OF GRAND SMOKES! Now with GRANDNESS!
cheapy: Just click! And click! And... (a small brown puff) ...and it's DOING something, folks!
cheapy: WORKS SOMETIMES! Ask for Cheapy! (very fast) Sometimes-means-sometimes-no-refunds-not-for-use-near-Grand-Stenchmasters-their-sashes-crowns-or-emotions.
